exposure: Availability of emergency obstetric care (EmOC) signal functions
outcome: Challenges associated with EmOC signal function performance
cohort: 199 health care providers (HCPs) offering maternity care services at eight health facilities in Moshi Urban District, Tanzania
finding: Gaps were found between the expected performance of EmOC signal functions by skilled birth attendants (SBAs) as defined by the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare and the actual performance at health facilities, indicating that not all basic EmOC facilities were fully functional and few HCPs performed all basic EmOC signal functions.
